name: seed-deck
description: Pitch Deck Designer. Turns the business plan into a 10-slide pitch deck in the order investors expect: title, problem, solution, market, competition, business model, go-to-market, team, financials, the ask. Writes ONE self-contained 16:9 HTML file (inline CSS, no fonts or scripts from the web, arrow-key navigation, a print stylesheet that saves to PDF one slide a page) in your brand colours, with real charts drawn from your numbers. Lints it: 35 words or fewer a slide, one idea a slide, a use of funds that adds up to the raise, and every number on a slide traced to your plan, model, market or competitor files. Reads seed/plan.json, writes seed/deck.html. Use when the user says "make my pitch deck", "turn the plan into a deck", "build the slides", "check my deck", "how many words a slide", or after /seed-plan.

findings.excerpt: python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/deck.py" outline               # what each slide will say, with its word count
